key_highlights: ASX finished flat with miners rising while oil stocks struggled; IDP plunged, but tech led gains after Wall Street surge (headlines 29, 65)
Saudi oil shock and drying global buffers driving Australian fuel prices higher, pressuring household budgets (23, 69)
Aussie flash PMI sags, signalling softening domestic activity amid RBA rate hike drag on spending (43, 49)
Gold exploration names surge: Critical Resources (Suriname), Aurum ($52.5M raise), Platina (Rio cheque) signal renewed junior gold momentum (33, 34, 68)
Critica rare earths offtake progress for WA Jupiter project supports critical minerals theme (32)
China property recovery question and robot rebalancing signal mixed signals for iron ore/coal demand (36, 73)
Jetstar industrial action escalates with fee waivers; Qantas confirms Sydney-New York non-stop (59, 63, 38)
Federal/state governments face debt cliff; Albanese migration speech and Hastie baby bonus debate add policy uncertainty (72, 45, 74)

sectors.trend: Miners rose on the day but China property recovery remains uncertain; robot rebalancing may shift demand away from bulk commodities. Junior gold names (Critical Resources, Aurum, Platina) surged on project milestones. Critica rare earths offtake progress supports critical minerals sub-sector.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face medium-term demand risk if China pivots to robotics/capex-light growth. Gold juniors (AUR.AX, CRG.AX, PLT.AX) offer tactical upside. Critica (CR8.AX) benefits from offtake visibility.

sectors.trend: Oil stocks struggled as Saudi supply shock and India's 48% oil import jump push prices higher but create volatility. WA abandoned oil platform costs shift to Commonwealth. Nuclear energy debate intensifies. Fuel price surge pressures household spending.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WEL.AX, GWO.AX face margin pressure from input costs. Woodside and Santos may benefit from higher realised prices but face political headwinds. Nuclear policy shift (headlines 4, 44) is a long-term structural catalyst for energy transition names.

sectors.trend: RBA rate hikes squeezing household spending; debt cliff for governments raises sovereign credit concerns. Fuel inflation pressures NIMs but also credit risk. Middle-income inequality and youth housing stress (half living with parents) signal consumer vulnerability.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face rising NPL risk from rate-sensitive borrowers. Government debt cliff (72) could pressure Commonwealth bond yields and bank funding costs. Defensive dividend appeal remains.

sectors.trend: Tech led ASX higher after Wall Street surge. $16B Aussie tech firm faces China-link controversy. AI theme dominant globally (Buffett/AI stocks, Meta AI agent, Nvidia). Data centre energy demand threatens net-zero targets.
sectors.implications: ASX tech names (WES.AX, XRO.AX, SPL.AX) benefit from global AI momentum but face geopolitical China-link risk. Data centre power demand (70) is a tailwind for energy infrastructure and a headwind for ESG-focused funds.

sectors.trend: Jetstar industrial action escalates with fee waivers; Qantas confirms SYD-JFK non-stop. Fuel price surge pressures transport margins. RBA rate drag on household spending. El Niño threatens agricultural output.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX benefits from route expansion but faces Jetstar (JLH.AX) competitive disruption. WES.AX, WOL.AX pressured by fuel costs and soft consumer spending. El Niño (71) is a medium-term risk for agribusiness (SUG.AX, TNL.AX).

sectors.trend: Syngenis gains precision medicine firepower. Healthcare sector globally under regulatory scrutiny (Mark Cuban comments). No major ASX healthcare headline today.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX, SYG.AX remain defensive anchors. Syngenis (SYG.AX) precision medicine venture adds pipeline optionality. Sector offers relative safety in volatile tape.

sectors.trend: Rising listings and falling demand driving property prices lower. Chinese property recovery question unresolved. Youth housing crisis (half living with parents) signals structural demand weakness.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICQ.AX, DGL.AX) face rental yield pressure if occupancies soften. Property developers (DHG.AX, MYC.AX) under pressure from falling prices. Monitor Chinese recovery for sentiment spillover.

key_themes: Commodity volatility: Saudi oil shock, India import surge, China demand pivot to robotics
RBA tightening cycle squeezing household balance sheets; fuel inflation a key transmission channel
Junior gold and critical minerals exploration momentum (WA, Suriname, West Africa)
AI and tech leadership globally, but China-link geopolitical risk for ASX tech
Government fiscal sustainability: debt cliff, energy cost political disputes
Industrial action in aviation (Jetstar) and broader labour tensions
El Niño as emerging agribusiness and insurance risk
Nuclear energy policy debate as long-term energy transition catalyst

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Fuel price surge from Saudi oil shock and drying global buffers
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge transport and consumer exposure; favour energy producers with hedged revenue. Monitor APM fuel prices weekly.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike drag on household spending and credit quality
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce leverage in rate-sensitive sectors (property, consumer discretionary). Monitor NAB/CBA NPL data and RBA statements.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: China demand pivot away from bulk commodities towards robotics
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify materials exposure beyond iron ore/coal; favour gold, critical minerals, and rare earths. Monitor Chinese PMI and property data.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Government debt cliff and fiscal sustainability
risk_assessment.mitigation: Watch Commonwealth bond yields; favour banks with strong capital buffers. Avoid over-exposure to government-linked contracts.
Maintain gold allocation (GSG.AX, GSR.AX) as hedge. Monitor AUD/USD for safe-haven flows.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: El Niño impact on agriculture and insurance
risk_assessment.mitigation: Review agribusiness and insurance exposures (SUG.AX, TNL.AX, CGF.AX, WPA.AX). Monitor BOM forecasts.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight junior gold and critical minerals explorers
opportunities.rationale: Multiple project milestones (Critical Resources, Aurum $52.5M raise, Platina Rio cheque) signal sector momentum; gold benefits from geopolitical risk and rate uncertainty

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical overweight ASX tech on global AI momentum
opportunities.rationale: Tech led ASX higher post Wall Street surge; AI theme dominant globally. But screen for China-link exposure to avoid geopolitical risk

opportunities.recommendation: Add energy producers with hedged revenue as fuel prices surge
opportunities.rationale: Saudi shock and India import surge support oil/gas prices; WDS and WEL benefit from higher realised prices despite political headwinds
Syngenis precision medicine adds pipeline; CSL and SGH offer stability amid rate and commodity volatility

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to rate-sensitive property and consumer discretionary
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA rate hikes squeezing spending; falling property prices and rising listings signal structural weakness; youth housing crisis indicates demand fragility

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge bulk commodity exposure (iron ore, coal) against China demand pivot
defensive_moves.rationale: China rebalancing towards robotics and uncertain property recovery threaten bulk commodity demand; diversify into gold and critical minerals

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash or short-duration bonds as fiscal risk builds
defensive_moves.rationale: Government debt cliff and energy cost political disputes create policy uncertainty; preserve dry powder for dislocation

defensive_moves.recommendation: Review aviation exposure amid Jetstar industrial action
defensive_moves.rationale: Escalating union action with fee waivers pressures JLH margins; QAN route expansion is positive but competitive dynamics shifting

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to range-trade with sector rotation. Tech and gold lead; oil and property lag. Fuel inflation and PMI softness cap upside. RBA communication and fuel price data are key swing factors. Expect volatility around 1-2% daily ranges.
market_outlook.long_term: Medium-term outlook cautious. China demand pivot, RBA tightening cycle, and fiscal sustainability concerns weigh on growth. Structural tailwinds in critical minerals, gold, AI/tech, and healthcare provide selective opportunities. El Niño adds agribusiness risk. Nuclear policy shift could reshape energy landscape over 12-24 months.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and statement (next scheduled meeting)
Australian flash PMI follow-through and CPI data
Saudi oil supply dynamics and global buffer inventory levels
China property and manufacturing data (robotics pivot signal)
Albanese migration policy and Hastie baby bonus decision
Nuclear energy policy developments (federal and US)
El Niño progression and BOM seasonal forecasts
watch_list: Iron ore (SGX), Brent crude, and gold spot prices
RBA cash rate and NAB/CBA NPL commentary
Chinese property sales and PMI data
Jetstar (JLH.AX) and Qantas (QAN.AX) share price action
Junior gold miners: CRG.AX, AUR.AX, PLT.AX, GSG.AX
Government bond yields (10-yr Commonwealth) for fiscal risk
El Niño indicators (BOM, sea surface temperatures)
